proposition: Demerzel's confidence-assignment threshold is calibrated against the observed overconfidence-then-revision rate in her belief states.

supporting.claim: 2 of 4 high-confidence beliefs (>= 0.85) were later revised (overconfidence_rate=0.5). Revisions evidenced by archived prior versions: 2026-03-17-consumer-repo-integration-status.belief.json, 2026-03-17-ga-governance-integration.belief.json. Nudge magnitude capped at +/-0.1/cycle per ml-governance-feedback-policy.
